source: Reviewed native tall/expanded presentations and optional Open Matte release metadata, with exact Cinemeta title/year/IMDb matches
rotation: Daily order of the complete pool on static fallback; live service reshuffles the complete pool on each fetch
limitations: Release-labelled Open Matte entries are discovery leads, not independently confirmed whole-film framing. Known variable-ratio titles and explicitly altered framing are excluded. Individual files are not played, downloaded or checked for TorBox availability.
